clauses.text: For columns, maximum tie spacing shall not exceed s₀ over a length l₀ measured from the joint face, where s₀ shall not exceed (i) 8 times the diameter of the smallest longitudinal bar enclosed, (ii) 24 times the diameter of the tie bar, (iii) one-half of the smallest cross-sectional dimension of the frame member, and (iv) 300 mm. the length l₀ over which the maximum tie spacing s₀ applies, measured from the joint face, shall not be less than (i) one-sixth of the clear span of the member, (ii) the maximum cross-sectional dimension of the member, and (iii) 450 mm.
clauses.notes:
s₀ - The maximum allowable tie spacing within the length l₀

Tie spacing - The center-to-center distance between successive transverse tie bars along the column length.

Tie bar diameter - The nominal diameter of the transverse tie reinforcing bar.

Smallest cross-sectional dimension - The lesser of the two cross-sectional dimensions (width or depth) of the column frame member.

l₀ - The minimum length measured from the joint face over which the tighter tie spacing s₀ must be maintained;

Clear span - The unobstructed length of the column between the faces of the supporting members.
